items.raw_excerpt: Emissions from carbon black manufacturer Birla Carbon were "a primary source" of the soot falling on Hamilton neighbourhoods in early July, Ontario's Ministry of the Environment, Conservation and Parks has said. Black dust falling on Hamilton homes is a perennial issue, especially near the eastern industrial sector.
items.summary_en: Ontario's environment ministry says Birla Carbon's emissions were a main cause of black soot falling on Hamilton homes in early July. Black dust on Hamilton homes is a common problem, especially near the eastern industrial area.
items.summary_ko: 온타리오 환경부가 카본블랙 제조사인 버라카본의 배출이 7월 초 해밀턴 주택가에 내린 검은 그을음의 주요 원인이라고 밝혔다. 해밀턴 주택에 검은 먼지가 내리는 것은 오랜 문제이며, 특히 동부 공업 지역 근처에서 자주 발생한다.

items.title_ko: 해밀턴 주택가 그을음의 주범은 카본블랙 공장, 환경부 확인

items.raw_excerpt: Alvin Tan left the technology sector before retrenchment could reach him. He now works longer hours, earns much less but has greater control over his future. Was it worth it, Money Mind asks.
items.summary_en: Alvin Tan left the technology sector before layoffs could reach him. He now works longer hours and earns much less. But he has greater control over his future.
